# VS Code Configuration

This directory contains workspace configurations for CartPro.

## Files

- `settings.json` - Workspace settings
- `extensions.json` - Recommended extensions
- `launch.json` - Debug configurations  
- `tasks.json` - Build and dev tasks
- `cartpro.code-snippets` - Code snippets

## Quick Start

1. Install recommended extensions
2. Press `Ctrl+Shift+B` to start dev server
3. Press `F5` for debug mode

See [VSCODE_GUIDE.md](../VSCODE_GUIDE.md) for full documentation.
